Function: Open the workout app. Access the customized feature you set.
Remarks: There are certain exceptional scenarios such as for calls and workouts.

The lock/unlock feature is only available with the following models: HONOR MagicWatch Series, HONOR Watch VIVIENNE TAM version, HONOR Watch Magic/ Dream Series, and HUAWEI WATCH GT Series. If you are using a HONOR Watch GS Pro, you can only press the Up button to lock or unlock screen, and press the Down button to switch screens during workouts. The watch screen is locked by default during swim workouts and cannot be unlocked.
Voice assistant is only available with phones that run EMUI 10.1.
